title: Psychology: Mind ki Basics
topic: Syllabus topics 1 to 7, ek reel mein
outside_book: Kent's Repertory opens with the Mind chapter (Mind, Vertigo, Head ...)
Organon §9, §211 and Kent's 'will and understanding' (homoeopathy texts)
the subconscious (preconscious) layer and its phone-number example
case taking → rubrics → Materia Medica comes from the syllabus's own course outcomes

beats.sub: Exam se pehle bas ye dekh lo
beats.vo: BHMS psychology ke pehle saat topics, ek hi reel mein. Exam se pehle bas ye dekh lo.

beats.title: Psychology kya hai?
beats.vo: Topic one: psychology kya hai?
Psychology is the scientific study of mind and behaviour. Psyche matlab life, logos matlab explanation.

beats.title: Hindsight bias
beats.vo: Science kyun? Kyunki common sense aksar galat hota hai. Result ke baad lagta hai, mujhe to pehle se pata tha. Ye hai hindsight bias.

beats.title: Empirical method
beats.vo: Isliye psychology empirical method use karti hai: data collect karo, organize karo, conclusion nikaalo. Test sirf facts hote hain, values nahi.

beats.title: Schools + unka Mind concept
beats.vo: Topic two aur four: schools, aur har school ka mind concept.

beats.title: Dualism · Descartes
beats.vo: Pehle Descartes ka dualism: mind, body se bilkul alag hai.
Phir aaya structuralism: Wundt aur Titchener. Introspection se mind ke basic elements dhoondhna.
Functionalism: William James. Unke liye thinking, doing ke liye hai.
Psychodynamic: Freud. Mind ek iceberg hai, zyada hissa unconscious.
Behaviourism: Watson aur Skinner. Mind ek black box hai, sirf stimulus aur response padho.
Cognitive: Bartlett aur Piaget. Mind har stimulus ko interpret karta hai.
Aur social-cultural: society aur culture hamari thinking aur behaviour ko shape karte hain.

beats.title: Homoeopath ko psychology kyun?
beats.vo: Topic three: homoeopath ko psychology kyun padhni hai?
Kent ki Repertory kholiye. Sabse pehla chapter? Mind.

beats.text: the state of the disposition often chiefly determines the remedy
beats.foot: Mental state aksar remedy decide karta hai
beats.vo: Organon ke aphorism 211 mein Hahnemann kehte hain: patient ka mental state aksar remedy decide karta hai.
beats.tts: Organon ke aphorism two eleven mein Hahnemann kehte hain: patient ka mental state aksar remedy decide karta hai.

beats.title: Psychology ka direct use
beats.vo: Isliye case taking mein emotions, thoughts, behaviour observe karo, unhe rubrics mein badlo, aur Materia Medica se match karo.

beats.title: Organon mein Mind
beats.vo: Topic five: Organon mein mind.

beats.text: the vital force keeps the organism in harmony, so the reason-gifted mind can use it for the higher purposes of existence
beats.vo: Aphorism 9: vital force body ko harmony mein rakhti hai, taaki hamara reason-gifted mind is body ko existence ke higher purposes ke liye use kar sake.
beats.tts: Aphorism nine: vital force body ko harmony mein rakhti hai, taaki hamara reason-gifted mind is body ko existence ke higher purposes ke liye use kar sake.

beats.title: Kent
beats.text:
Man = will + understanding
Body = the house he lives in
beats.vo: Kent ke liye insaan asal mein will aur understanding hai, aur body woh ghar hai jismein woh rehta hai.

beats.title: Mind: do nazariye
beats.vo: Psychology mind ko scientific method aur behaviour se padhti hai. Organon use totality ka hissa maanta hai. Par dono maante hain: mind aur body ek hain.

beats.title: Conscious · Subconscious · Unconscious
beats.vo: Topic six: conscious, subconscious aur unconscious.
Ek experiment mein log zyada tar wahi chai chunte the jiske naam mein unke apne naam ke letters the. Par nabbe percent se zyada ne kaha: taste dekh ke chuni.

beats.note: Conscious: jo abhi aapki awareness mein hai
beats.vo: Freud ke hisaab se mind ek iceberg hai. Upar ka tip hai conscious: jo abhi aapki awareness mein hai.

beats.note: Subconscious: abhi dhyan mein nahi, par yaad aa jaaye (phone number)
beats.vo: Surface ke theek neeche subconscious: abhi dhyan mein nahi, par koshish karo to yaad aa jaaye, jaise kisi ka phone number.

beats.note: Unconscious: sabse bada, chhupa hua, behaviour chalata hai
beats.vo: Aur neeche sabse bada hissa unconscious, jo chupke se behaviour chalata hai. Ye dikhta hai dreams mein, slips of the tongue mein, obsessions mein, aur hypnosis mein.

beats.title: Mind ke 3 expressions
beats.vo: Topic seven: mind ke teen expressions.
Sadak par achanak truck dikha. Aapne socha khatra, dar laga, aur aap ruk gaye.
Socha, yaani cognition: perception, thinking, memory aur judgement.

beats.note: Dar = Affect: emotion + motivation. Arousal: dil tez, pupils dilate, paseena
beats.vo: Dar, yaani affect: emotions aur motivation. Isme arousal hota hai: dil tez, pupils dilate, paseena.

beats.note: Ruk gaye = Conation: behaviour, jo hum karte hain
beats.vo: Aur ruk gaye, yaani conation: behaviour, jo hum karte hain.

beats.note: Teeno ek doosre ko aur body ko affect karte hain
beats.vo: Teeno ek doosre ko aur body ko affect karte hain.
